class.name: NNBTScoreBasedPicker
class.brief_description: Evaluates its enabled child nodes using their child considerations and ticks the highest-scoring one.
class.description: The score-based picker evaluates its enabled direct behaviour tree children when a run starts, using each child's enabled direct [NNConsiderations] children (such as [NNConsideration], [NNConsiderationGroup] or [NNCustomPropertyConsideration]) aggregated according to that child's [member NNBTNodes.evaluation_method]. The enabled child with the highest score is selected and ticked, and the picker returns that child's result. On a tie, the first enabled child in child order wins. A child with no enabled considerations evaluates to a score of [code]0.0[/code] and is still eligible to be picked if no other child scores higher. If the picker has no enabled behaviour tree children, it returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]. The choice is made when a run starts and kept until the run ends, so a child added during a run joins the next run. If the chosen child is removed during a run the picker returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE], and the next run chooses a new child from the surviving children.
